author: Doug Coats
title: Free dental clinic available in Gastonia this weekend - NewsBreak
text:
By Doug Coats ,
2 hours ago
GASTONIA, N.C. (QUEEN CITY NEWS) -- This week in Gastonia, hundreds of adults will have an opportunity to receive dental care without paying a dime.
On Friday and Saturday, October 2-3, the North Carolina Dental Society Foundation’s Missions of Mercy program will bring volunteer dentists, hygienists and other dental professionals together to provide free dental care to more than 600 adults.
Changes to Medicaid, SNAP take effect Oct. 1 in North Carolina The organization says many patients who come to these clinics have not seen a dentist in years, while others arrive experiencing significant pain and in need of immediate care.
Over the two days, patients can receive exams, X-rays, cleanings, fillings, extractions and partials, all at no-cost.
The services are provided at City Church, 3100 City Church St. On Friday, it operates from 6 a.m. 5 p.m. and from 6 a.m. to 3 p.m. Saturday.
Care is offered on a first come, first served basis. No one under the age of 18 may be treated.
"For people who have had to choose between the cost of dental care and other necessities, this clinic offers an opportunity to address problems they may have been living with for far too long," Missions of Mercy said.
